videos.title: 晶片如何製成？ASML Nanoland 第 6 集
videos.titleEn: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.originalTitle: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.author: ASML
videos.captionNote: 字幕與自動翻譯依原平台提供，未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「CMOS 影像感測器製作」的延伸背景。以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for CMOS image-sensor fabrication. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「像素訊號鏈：建立模型」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Pixel signal chain: construct and analyze requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「像素隔離：建立模型」列為查證任務：光學隔離與電荷隔離不是同一件事；深溝槽也可能引入新表面缺陷。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Pixel isolation: construct and analyze: Optical isolation and charge isolation differ; Deep trenches can introduce new surface defects.
videos.rights: External official embed/link only. Copyright remains with the publisher; no download or rehosting license is claimed.

courses.overview: 從「CMOS 影像感測器製作」延伸比較單光子雪崩二極體陣列、晶圓薄膜橢圓偏光量測：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend CMOS image-sensor fabrication by comparing Single-photon avalanche-diode arrays and Wafer thin-film ellipsometry: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 兩者都可透過背照與堆疊讀出改善光收集與電路配置，像素與邏輯介面同樣重要。
related.transferEn: Both can use backside illumination and stacked readout to improve light collection and circuit allocation; pixel/logic interfaces matter.
related.difference: 一般 CMOS 成像累積光電荷；SPAD 像素偵測離散雪崩事件並受死區時間影響。飽和容量與最大計數率不是同一指標。
related.differenceEn: Conventional CMOS imaging accumulates charge; SPAD pixels detect discrete avalanches with dead time. Full-well capacity and maximum count rate are different metrics.
practice: 比較電荷積分與事件計數兩條訊號鏈。
在堆疊剖面標出光敏層、互連與讀出層。
區分暗電流、暗計數及讀出雜訊。
practiceEn: Compare charge-integration and event-counting signal chains.
Label photosensitive, interconnect and readout layers in a stack.
Distinguish dark current, dark counts and read noise.
related.title: 單光子雪崩二極體陣列

place.name: Hamamatsu Photonics 濱松總部
place.coordinateScope: 官方內嵌地圖標記的近似總部點；不是 APD/SPAD 加工設備位置。

related.why: 兩者都可透過背照與堆疊讀出改善光收集與電路配置，像素與邏輯介面同樣重要。
related.whyEn: Both can use backside illumination and stacked readout to improve light collection and circuit allocation; pixel/logic interfaces matter.

related.transfer: 成像器的抗反射層與薄膜光學常數影響光穿透；橢偏可提供模型化膜厚／n、k 證據。
related.transferEn: Sensor antireflection layers and optical constants affect transmission; ellipsometry provides model-based thickness and n/k evidence.
related.difference: 成像驗收關乎像素響應、飽和及雜訊；橢偏量測偏振變化。好的薄膜擬合不能獨自證明像素功能。
related.differenceEn: Imaging qualification concerns response, saturation and noise; ellipsometry measures polarization change. A good film fit cannot alone prove pixel function.
practice: 畫光從表面薄膜到光二極體的路徑。
比較不同 n、k 與厚度對反射模型的耦合。
把膜厚證據與像素光譜響應交叉比對。
practiceEn: Trace light through surface films into the photodiode.
Compare coupling among n, k and thickness in reflection models.
Cross-check film evidence against pixel spectral response.

courses.summary: 本課以「imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從像素訊號鏈、完整電荷轉移到感測器驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From Pixel signal chain and Complete charge transfer to Sensor acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
